desc: Allen's Eliminator Pro Double Compartment Shooting Bag is the perfect shell bag for a day at the range or out in the field. Great for skeet/trap shooting or anyone looking for a shooting vest alternative. This lightweight bag features molded components, so it is strong enough to hold all your gear in the separated compartments with a removable divider, plus a bottom zipper to empty out your spent shotgun shells quickly. One side pocket has three choke tube loops, and the other can be used for smaller accessories, like ear plugs or sunscreen. Adjustable, wide belt with durable buckle included. Also includes a D-ring to hold your towel or shooting glasses.
